statement: Do not use em dashes: use colons, commas, semicolons, parentheses, or new sentences.
user_prompt_quote: The big blurbs of text, you might know I don't like those... No em dashes

statement: Introduce a referent before using 'this' or 'it'; qualify noun phrases with which one or whose.
user_prompt_quote: Use plain language and qualify noun phrases

statement: Author content prose that directly defines the subject, not explanatory narrative that defends the implementation.
user_prompt_quote: That would be content prose, not explanatory prose, and it implies the content rather than explaining it

statement: Never use the word 'carrier' for a data file; use 'registry' or specify the exact artifact.
user_prompt_quote: The word carrier, I think, possibly should be added to banned phrases... It is an attractive nuisance, it gets substituted where we should simply say registry

statement: Never use the vague container word 'tray'; describe explicit components or data outlines.
user_prompt_quote: You use the word tray above and should not have... That was just trying to say too much at once and not saying any of it clearly

statement: Do not introduce binding directives (e.g. 'never do X') into documentation without express user approval for the exact wording.
user_prompt_quote: Do not add directives (e.g., 'never do x') without express user approval for the exact wording

statement: Registries are always CSV files, never JSON or embedded structures.
user_prompt_quote: I thought we actually clarified that registries are always csv, not json

statement: Session records are captured artifacts that are immutable on read and committed eagerly rather than at wrap-up.
user_prompt_quote: Not hand-edited, so not authored. Not regenerable... A lost captured file is gone.

statement: Every repeated statement in the coordination layer must have exactly one authoritative file registered in docs/owners.csv.
user_prompt_quote: For a statement the coordination layer repeats, which file is authoritative

statement: Emit exactly one closing state glyph and bold state name per user prompt; never emit surplus closing states on PR wakes.
user_prompt_quote: I'd like to take a look at my surfacing MD and specifically the codes that we use for status... clean exit

statement: Silence assistant messages during CI polling runs when no substantive state change has occurred.
user_prompt_quote: Guidance should silence agent messages when no substantive state change has occurred

statement: Every assistant must prefix git branches with its assigned identifier (claude/, codex/, gemini/, grok/).
user_prompt_quote: Every assistant identifies its work by branch prefix and commit trailer

statement: Every assistant must append its recognized trailer or signature to all commit messages.
user_prompt_quote: Include trailer on all commits so Activity can classify branches

statement: Do not use stat cards in HTML interfaces; keep tabular data and clean layouts.
user_prompt_quote: It has stat cards, which I always ask you to remove. We should have some kind of a standing house style for HTML where we mention not to use stat cards.

statement: Do not use CSS text-wrap: balance on introductory ledes; text must occupy the measure it is given.
user_prompt_quote: keep content on the viewport and don't have to scroll at the broader level... text takes the width it is given
